title: A2A Handoff Envelope Schema
description: Standardized envelope for structured Agent-to-Agent handoffs in agent-meta. Wraps any domain-specific payload with metadata for validation, supersession tracking, and traceability. Hard constraint: source_agent MUST NOT equal target_agent — self-handoffs are structurally forbidden and MUST be rejected by the consuming agent.

protocol_version.description: SemVer version of the A2A handoff protocol itself (not the payload schema).

handoff_id.description: Globally unique handoff identifier: HOFF-{YYYYMMDD}-{sequential or random suffix}.

source_agent.description: Role name of the agent producing this handoff (e.g. 'se-architect', 'ideation').

target_agent.description: Role name of the agent intended to consume this handoff (e.g. 'se-critic', 'requirements').

supersession.description: Optional. Tracks versioning and replacement of prior handoffs. Present when this handoff supersedes a previous one.

supersedes.description: handoff_id of the previous handoff that this one replaces.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the supersession (e.g. 'critic rejection: missing traceability').

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this supersession was created.

history.description: Optional. Full revision history: ordered list of all superseded handoff_ids from the beginning of the chain. The last entry is identical to 'supersedes'. Enables downstream agents to see the full revision chain, not just the immediate predecessor.

batch.description: Optional. When true, payload is an array of task objects for FANOUT delegation. Each array entry has a task_id (local to the batch) plus domain-specific fields. source_agent and target_agent apply to ALL tasks in the batch. Default: false.

schema_ref.description: URI reference to the JSON Schema that validates the payload. Supports relative paths (e.g. 'schemas/se-decomposition.schema.json') and absolute URLs.

payload.description: The domain-specific data being handed over. Must conform to the schema referenced by schema_ref. When batch is true, payload is an array of task objects — each with a task_id (local to the batch) plus domain-specific fields. source_agent and target_agent apply to ALL tasks in the batch.

delegation_depth.description: Depth of this handoff in the delegation chain. 0 = main chat, 1 = orchestrator, 2+ = worker/sub-worker. Envelopes with delegation_depth exceeding the configured max (project.yaml → orchestrator.delegation.max_depth, default 10) MUST be rejected. Self-handoff (source_agent == target_agent) is enforced separately and cannot be disabled.

trace_parent.description: Optional. handoff_id of the parent handoff that triggered this one. Enables full delegation-tree tracing.

trace_context.description: Extended trace context for distributed tracing across the agent cascade. Links to viz-handshake task_id.

trace_id.description: Globally unique trace ID spanning the entire cascade.

span_id.description: Current span ID for this specific handoff.

viz_task_id.description: References the viz-handshake task_id for cross-referencing execution tracking. Links the Data Contract Layer (A2A) to the Operational Layer (viz).

requires_human_approval.description: Optional. When true, the downstream agent MUST pause before execution and wait for explicit user confirmation before proceeding. Enforced at the prompt level (see developer.md, orchestrator.md, _reference-agent.md) — no automatic code-level interception, consistent with this framework's other HITL/guard rules. Default: false.

metadata.description: Optional. Extensible key-value store for provider-specific or workflow-specific metadata. May include 'provider_handoff_format' ('json'|'yaml_text_block'|'file') to indicate the transport format used, and other provider-specific hints.
